title: Benchmarks and metrics for face reconstruction accuracy

queue.claim: NoW non-metrical reference numbers: scaled average FLAME ≈1.53 mm mean, MICA ≈0.90/1.11 mm median/mean, best 2023–25 entries ≈0.75–0.8/≈0.95 mm; the late-2026 leader is unknown
queue.query: NoW challenge leaderboard non-metrical median mean error mm MICA

queue.claim: NoW protocol: the submitter supplies 7 landmarks (4 eye corners, a nose point, 2 mouth corners); a similarity fit seeds a rigid refinement on scan-to-mesh distance; error runs from each scan vertex to the predicted surface; scale is solved except in MICA's metrical track; derived from Feng et al. FG 2018
queue.query: now_evaluation 7 landmarks rigid alignment scan-to-mesh distance scale NoW benchmark

queue.claim: Stereophotogrammetry scanners are accurate to about 0.1–0.5 mm on rigid targets, and repeat captures of a live face differ by about 0.3–1 mm RMS, so ground truth is uncertain by about 0.3–0.5 mm
queue.query: 3dMD stereophotogrammetry reproducibility repeated facial captures mm RMS live subjects

queue.claim: REALY protocol (keypoint global alignment, then per-region ICP over nose, mouth, forehead and cheek; per-region mean nearest-point error) and frontal-track region errors of about 1.5–2.2 mm on average, with the mouth showing the largest spread
queue.query: REALY benchmark region-aware ICP nose mouth forehead cheek error mm HRN Deep3D DECA
